verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a dedicated Keyboard shortcuts help article, and one hands-on user report says the interface is much faster than ProtonMail, so the shortcut and speed elements have some support. The evidence gives only the article title, so it does not show how comprehensive the shortcuts are or that everything can be done from the keyboard. Nothing in the pack mentions a command palette. Missing for 10: a command palette, evidence of comprehensive keyboard-only coverage, first-party or measured evidence of UI responsiveness, and independent corroboration beyond a single anecdote.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait

citations.quote: Fastmail was a ton faster and didn't randomly forget my sessions.
